comparator.name: Econometrics and Data Science
comparator.sourceNotes: The official 2026–2027 curriculum provides a complete 180-EC structure. Years 1 and 2 each contain ten 6-EC components. Year 3 contains 30 EC of genuine open first-semester choice, an 18-EC specialisation and a 12-EC thesis seminar. The generic programme offers Econometrics and Data Science specialisations. Econometrics is selected under the broad-academic-identity rule because the official overview distinguishes the degree from more data-driven Business Analytics through its theory-driven econometric modelling of microeconomic, macroeconomic and policy questions; it is also listed first. Risk Theory is selected by official order from the two second-year restricted choices. Both decisions were fixed before UCR fit was assessed.

comparatorRouteSelection.basis: The normalized target is the generic Econometrics and Data Science degree. Current official evidence presents econometric model development, interpretation, economic causality and policy analysis as the programme’s distinctive broad identity, while Data Science is the more prediction- and automation-focused alternative. Econometrics is therefore selected as the representative route, independently of UCR fit; its first listing also supports the choice if the routes are treated as equally general.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The closest route owns the integrated econometrics core. The formally evidenced Data Science direction supports a technically distinct AI and automation curriculum, while financial data analysis and data-driven organisational decisions support a third application-focused route. All three are coherent, feasible and pairwise distinct by at least four courses, so production stops at the maximum.

notes.text: UvA provides successive calculus, linear algebra, probability, statistics and econometrics courses, an empirical project, a formal Econometrics specialisation and a 12-EC thesis seminar. UCR offers mathematics, statistics, programming, data science, machine learning and one dedicated Econometrics course, but not the same advanced econometric sequence, time-series and microeconometrics depth, life-insurance mathematics or embedded quantitative thesis requirement.
